description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “Palazzo Unit 306,” a spacious Gulf-front condo overlooking the white sand and emerald waters of Panama City Beach. Located on the 7th floor, this 2-bedroom, 2-bath retreat comfortably sleeps 6 with an additional Twin-over-Twin bunk nook and plenty of space to settle in after a day on the beach. Start the morning with coffee on the Gulf-front balcony, spend the afternoon by the community pool or walk straight from the resort to the sand. Back upstairs, panoramic Gulf views set the scene for dinner on the balcony and evenings spent watching the sun set over the water. With Pier Park just minutes away, “Palazzo Unit 306” gives you the best of the beach with Panama City Beach favorites close by. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf-Front Condo with panoramic views of the Gulf7th-Floor Location with a spacious private balcony overlooking the beachSleeps 6 Comfortably with 2 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms and a Twin bunk nookDirect Beach Access located behind the condo buildingCommunity Pool overlooking the GulfSpacious, Fully Equipped Kitchen with stainless steel appliances and plenty of prep spaceConvenient West Panama City Beach Location just minutes from Pier Park*** LIVING AREAS ***The Gulf takes center stage in the living area, where comfortable seating and direct balcony access make it easy to settle into vacation mode. Spend the afternoon relaxing inside after a day in the sun or step outside and let the panoramic water views do the entertaining.Spacious living area with ample comfortable seatingFlat-screen TV for relaxed evenings at the condoDirect access to the private Gulf-front balconyPanoramic Gulf views from the main living space*** KITCHEN & DINING ***The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need for easy mornings, beach-day lunches and dinners at home. Stainless steel appliances, generous counter space and plenty of storage make preparing meals simple, while the nearby dining area gives everyone a place to gather.Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliancesAmple counter and storage spaceDining table with seating for 6Easy flow between the kitchen, dining area and Gulf-front living space*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Two comfortable bedrooms plus a separate bunk nook give families and small groups flexible sleeping arrangements, while two full bathrooms make it easy for everyone to get ready for another day on the beach.Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony access and En-suite with single vanity, walk-in shower and oversized soaking tubQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed and flat-screen TVBunk Nook: Twin-over-Twin bunk bedsGuest Bathroom: Conveniently accessible from the hallway with single vanity and shower/tub combo*** LOCATION & PALAZZO RESORT AMENITIES ***“Palazzo Unit 306” puts the Gulf right outside your door while keeping some of Panama City Beach’s favorite spots just minutes away. Spend the day by the Gulf-front pool, walk directly from the resort to the white sand or head to nearby Pier Park for shopping, dining and entertainment. Located on the west end of Panama City Beach, Palazzo also makes it easy to explore more of PCB or head toward 30A for the day.Direct Beach Access to the white-sand beaches of Panama City BeachElevated Gulf-Front Community Pool overlooking the waterPier Park nearby for shopping, dining, entertainment and seasonal eventsRussell-Fields Pier near Pier Park for beautiful Gulf views and time by the waterConvenient west-end location for exploring Panama City Beach and nearby 30A*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentHOA requires a 3-night stay minimum year-round*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate condo designed for comfort, connection and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR ESCAPE! *** Read less
